N002.summary: As the game progresses, you begin to define your army composition, leaning towards ground forces with Marines and Reapers. Continue developing your ground army and maintain heavy defense. Keep production moderate but be ready to increase it if needed.

N003.summary: In the midgame, you have a heavy production capacity and a well-rounded ground army, including Siege Tanks, Marines, Hellions, and Medivacs. Maintain your heavy production and continue to build a balanced ground army. Keep defense strong and be prepared to adapt to opponent moves.
